name: Pine Amber
description: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, now shining with vivid, radiant hues.
fullDescription: A gem formed from the resin of the towering ancient trees that once blanketed Nod-Krai. Over the ages, the resin hardened into crystalline amber, which now shines with vivid, radiant hues.\nSnezhnayan scholars believe that before the pioneering age, vast primordial forests once stretched across Nod-Krai. The widespread traces of Pine Amber found today are considered strong evidence of these ancient woodlands. According to tales, the ancestors of the Frostmoon Scions turned away from all crafts that could be deemed to be civilized. Though that begs the question — how did they bring forth the towering palaces and lofty spires that mark their legacy?
